identity.name: GoUltraAI
identity.description: A brand-first marketing execution system for marketers managing multiple brands. Combines modular workflow apps with an action plan engine.
identity.mission: Make structured, AI-enhanced marketing accessible to every brand.
identity.vision: Every marketer operates from a system, not scattered tools.

values.description: Every output is actionable — no fluff, no filler.
All outputs customized from the source of truth.
You control the AI, not the other way around.

identity.brand_archetype: Creator — Driven to build something meaningful and lasting. Values innovation and bringing ideas to life through structured systems.
identity.elevator_pitch: GoUltraAI gives you a complete marketing system for your brand. Create one workspace with your profile, offers, voice rules, and audience. Then our workflow apps generate action plans, content briefs, and execution checklists across every channel. You bring the AI. We bring the system.

voice.primary_tone: Practical, clear, and confident — like a senior marketing strategist who gives you the system, not just the theory. Direct without being cold, supportive without being hand-holdy.
dos: Show concrete examples, not abstract advice
Write like you're talking to a smart colleague
donts: Never use jargon without explaining it first
Never write walls of text without structure
voice.sample_texts:
New in GoUltraAI: Content Calendar Generator.

Your brand workspace now builds weekly content calendars across all channels. One click. Every platform covered.

1. Open workspace
2. Set channels
3. Generate → review → publish

Try it: goultraai.com/calendar

messaging.primary_message: Stop duct-taping your marketing. Build a system.
supporting_messages: One workspace per brand. Every channel. Execution-ready outputs.
AI is your co-pilot. The system is your flight plan.
From blank to plan. System, not tools.

headlines.headline: Onboard Clients in Minutes. Deliver Plans in Hours.
I Built a Marketing System That Runs Itself (Here's How)

market.positioning: GoUltraAI is the only brand-first marketing execution system that combines modular workflow apps with a built-in action plan engine — unlike generic AI tools, template marketplaces, or disconnected SaaS stacks.

competitors.name: Jasper AI
competitors.description: AI content generation platform for marketing teams
competitors.comparison: Jasper generates content; GoUltraAI provides the system that turns content into execution.

competitors.name: Copy.ai
competitors.description: AI writing assistant and workflow automation
competitors.comparison: Copy.ai is a writing tool; GoUltraAI is a marketing execution system.

competitors.name: Notion + ChatGPT (DIY stack)
competitors.description: Manual combination of productivity and AI tools
competitors.comparison: The DIY stack is what most marketers use today. GoUltraAI replaces the duct tape with a system.

differentiators.evidence: No other system generates outputs directly from a unified brand workspace.
SEO, Social, Ads, Video all read from the same workspace.
Auto-generates weekly action plans based on brand goals and channels.
